description: MIDI Adapter Configuration for MilkV Duo S - Universal Device Format

usb_midi.comment: USB MIDI input device (keyboard, controller, etc.). Auto-discovered by the system.

din_midi.comment: Hardware UART for DIN MIDI. Direction: input (receive), output (send), or both (bidirectional).

network_midi_studio.comment: Network MIDI using RTP-MIDI. Direction 'input' = server mode (receive), 'output' = client mode (send to target_ip).

gpio_pedal.comment: GPIO button for footpedal control. Trigger on falling edge (button press).

gpio_button2.comment: Second GPIO button for reconnecting MIDI devices.

osc_bridge.comment: OSC to MIDI bridge (optional, requires additional dependencies). Direction: input (receive OSC), output (send OSC), or both.

default.description: Default routing: USB MIDI to both DIN and Network

routes.comment: Route USB MIDI to DIN MIDI output
Route USB MIDI to Network MIDI simultaneously

studio.description: Studio profile: Bidirectional USB<->Network, DIN output only

performance.description: Performance profile: All inputs to all outputs

settings.comment: Global settings. auto_connect will automatically establish routes on startup.

_notes.device_types: Supported: usb_midi, uart_midi, network_midi_rtp, gpio_input, osc_midi (experimental)
_notes.aliases: Use device aliases in routing for clarity (e.g., 'usb_midi', 'din_midi' instead of port numbers)
_notes.direction_network: network_midi_rtp direction: 'input' (server mode, receive from network), 'output' (client mode, send to target_ip - requires target_ip)
_notes.usb_midi: USB MIDI devices are auto-discovered. Use 'usb_midi' as source name in routing.
_notes.gpio_numbers: Use duo-pinmux or WiringX to identify GPIO numbers for your board.
_notes.midi_ports_fallback: You can still use ALSA port numbers (e.g., '14:0') if needed for advanced routing.
_notes.uart_device: Common UART devices: /dev/ttyS0-5. Check your device tree for the correct one.
_notes.network_midi: Direction 'input' = server (no target_ip). Direction 'output' = client (requires target_ip).
_notes.routing_profiles: Switch profiles using GPIO actions or by editing active_profile and restarting the service.
_notes.routing_format: Source and destination can be device names (usb_midi, din_midi, etc.) or ALSA ports (14:0).
_notes.osc_midi: OSC MIDI bridge is experimental and requires python-osc package.
